comparison.objective: Candidate performs condition-based carton rejection; PR-2185 refits a mixer beater and verifies a guarded powered start-stop cycle.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests moving-object interception and spill-free transport around flaps. PR-2185 tests slotted-hub alignment, spring-collar compression, twist retention, guard placement and machine control operation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires correct reject/pass routing with stable released placement and retained contents. PR-2185 requires retained beater and guard assembly, raised bowl, sustained specified rotation, safe stop and hand clearance.
comparison.reason: Mechanical attachment plus guarded powered verification is materially different from conveyor sorting and loaded-carton handling. No material rubric detail is missing.
